Are you ready to get down and dirty to win? Bump and bounce through the mud in this super fast, single-screen arcade racer.

Zoom through 18 different tracks across three stages filled with tight turns, long straights, off road hazards and crazy jumps! Up to four players can join the the fun, or you play the game as a single player challenge!

Compete for the best time in a single race, or take on the ultimate Championship mode and see who finishes on top of the leaderboard. Watch out for the different personalities of the computer drivers: Torquey Tom, Nitro Nigel, Revvy Rick and Oily Olive.

Use the shop to strategise your upgrades. Turn your car into the ultimate racing machine, or stock up on nitro boosts and oil slicks and choose your moments in the race. Speed away from the pack with a nitro, or send your opponents into a spin out with a well timed oil slick!

207042.overview:
A fast loading version of Maniac Mansion with additional graphics. 

The Edison mansion has always been a creepy old house on the edge of town. There have been rumors of strange experiments going on and of odd creatures living amongst the Edison family. There is even a story that a meteorite once crashed near the home nearly 20 years ago. More immediately, a girl named Sandy has gone missing from the local high school and her boyfriend Dave swears that he saw Dr. Fred abducting her. Dave knows that he cannot do it alone and will need help from two other students if he has any hope of infiltrating the mansion and rescuing Sandy.

Players start by choosing two students to accompany Dave to the Edison mansion, and can then switch between these three characters at will. Most actions are carried out by selecting verbs on the screen and applying them to an object (such as "OPEN Door"). Each character maintains a separate personality and may have a different way to solve a problem from his classmates. Thus many of the puzzles can be overcome in different ways depending on the character being used. If any one of the kids are captured by the Edison's, they are thrown into the dungeon and must be rescued themselves by any character who still has their freedom.

207302.overview:
Madman is an interesting take on Pong/Breakout (the came plays like a cross between both of those two games. It's like breakout in that you have bricks (well in this case balls) to destroy, but it's also like Pong in that you have an AI opponent competing against you.

This game was developed by Alan W, Gardner and published in both Loadtar #004 and later in Loadstar #249

207303.overview:
Madix is a fairly original puzzler in which you have to dispose of the ever-regenerating blue cubes and then the flashing pink one (ooer). Gets harder (ooer) but doesn't really go anywhere.

Developed by Mark Judge and published in Commodore Disk User 1991/07.

207388.overview: Monster Panic is an early homebrew game for the the Commodore 64. It is a clone of Space Panic, and was developed by Timothy Bogen and released as part of the Jim Green PD #04 Compilation in 1983.

207683.overview:
Millie and Molly is a retro inspired puzzle game coded and designed by industry veterans for original Commodore 64 hardware and emulators. We teamed up with the most talented people in the C64 scene including Saul Cross for the graphics and Hasse Axelsson-Svala for the music.

The game features 100 original levels spread over five themed worlds, eight pieces of music and even a level editor should you wish to get your creative juices flowing. The game works on both PAL and NTSC formats.

The game was made free in July of 2022.

207740.overview: Missile Alert is a clone of Missile Command for the Commodore 64. It was developed by German based developer Technische Maschinenfabrik and released into the public domain in 2009.

207742.overview: A scrolling screen platformer by Bad Bytes (Mathew Cox, Dwayne J. Bakewell, Matthew McHugo & Kellie) New and released in 1999 in Loadstar #185, Loadstar #248, and also in Reset #10 Mix-i-Disk. In this game you will find yourself jumping for keys in a side-scrolling winter wonderland. A jump and shoot game from Bad Bytes, an Australian coding group. There are 5 worlds to explore and each one contains five keys that must be gathered to a chest. You can move your little guy underneath square blocks and bump into them changing color or giving a power up icon. Some will contain keys. You can also find, coins, extra time, point bonuses and 3 different attack powers. If you pass a check point marker it will change colors and you can start there if you die. Remember there is a time limit so you have to hunt and kill fast.

208691.overview:
mini MIKE and the Caverns of Doom - A challenging C64 demo featuring a tiny character that is a bit like Load Runner, except with deadly traps. 
 
In the game you play as a little tiny man called MIKE and must traverse through each screen rescuing other tiny people while also avoiding being killed by deadly enemies and nasty spiked traps. What makes the demo so enjoyable, is not only is the game nice to look at (feels more like a modern indie game) but it's very smooth to play with responsive controls, has some well thought out challenges 
 
Can you help Mike solve the puzzles, avoid the Nasties, save his friends and escape with his life?

208692.overview: The first quiz created using his new Just Another Quiz Engine, Lucas Gruber, has created this preview of quizzes to come. A movie quiz game in english.

209025.overview:
Your spacecraft is caught in the middle of a beautiful but deadly meteor shower. As ship commander can you survive? A challenging space game with outstanding graphics. 

As you glide through outer space, meteors of many colors swirl past your spaceship. You'd like to stop and watch the display, but you better keep moving — a collision with a meteor means the end of your ship. If you act fast, you can dodge the meteors and ward them off with your ship's photon gun. 

Published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1986/07 (Issue #37), and also in Stonysoft #0343

209073.overview:
Developed by MP Software (Peter Vass & Marco Pistorio) in 2017, Mr. Wong's Loopy Laundry is a 2017 unofficial homebrew conversion of the 1984 ZX Spectrum game of the same name for the Commodore 64.

Game description:

Mr. Wong's Loopy Laundry is a platform game with static scenarios. Each scenario corresponds to a different level with increased difficulty and is divided by floors connected by ladders.

Mr. Wong, the character the player will incarnate, is the owner of this laundry and his job consists in picking and putting all the scattered pieces of clothing in the laundry chute, accessed through the upper right corner of the scenario. He has to repeat this process for each piece of clothing because he has no washing basket to carry them all at once. To make more difficult his job there are many entities which will try to stop him from doing his job as a possessed iron, a bag of dirty laundry or soap suds.

As a weapon of defence, Mr. Wong has a limited quantity of starch which can be charged against his obstacles, temporarily paralysing them. When it'll ran out, the player can recharge it by picking new bags of starch which will randomly materialize just a few moments after.

209199.overview: A SEUCK based shooter from Scarzix, released in 1988.

210031.overview:
A fantastically odd little maze game, Microdot involves rolling a ball around a series of screens with the purpose of collecting radioactive particles. The game is similar to Jet Set Willy but it's simple graphical style, fast play-speed and the inclusion of a level editor set this one apart from the rest. On the few occasions I got to play on my mate's C64, this was the game that impressed me the most.
 
Published in several compilations and publications including Commodore Disk User 1989/01-02, Your Commodore 1990/01 (Tape #01), and in Your Commodore 1991/10 (Tape #22).

210035.overview:
A recent recovery in 2021 and lost for well over 30 years, The Mad Scientist was sent to several major software houses at the time in the 80’s, such as Kele Line – who seemed most likely to publish. Unfortunately, when Kele Line went bankrupt, the game disappeared with them.

Thanks to the graphics artist Jens Christian Thomsen, the game was preserved from an old tape and released via CSDB. The game itself is a neat split screen helicopter game, which feels a heck of a lot like Elite’s Airwolf, and surely must have been inspired by it.

We hope to learn more about the title from the team in the future, but for now, check out the game for yourself and see a title that could have been a lot of fun with two players. Though of course with as much hair pulling as with Elite’s Airwolf!

210036.overview: A Space Invaders style shooter created by Ashley Routledge, David Saunders & Simon Nicol  with music by Rob Hubbard and published in 1988 in both Commodore Zone Issue #05 (May/June 1996), and in Commodore Zone Issue #13.

210511.overview: Aim of this game is like Needle in the Haystack. The idea of this game is to search for the matching combination of colours within a certain amount of time.

210515.overview: A horizontally scrolling shooter created by Adriano Pareto and published in the Jackson Soft Compilation #8 / no definite name, called "Missione" in the magazine.

210593.overview: A SEUCK based vertically scrolling shoot'em up by Johnathan Wells and published in several places including Commodore Format 1993/04 (Issue #31) + 1994/01 (Issue #40), and Commodore Zone Issue #05. From the creator of the Twin Tigers, comes THE greatest dinosaur blast-out ever.

210594.overview:
Mafia is set in the Chicago of the 1920's and casts you as a small time criminal who has to become "boss of the underworld". Starting out with smaller crimes like robberies and smuggling alcohol, you gain points and eventually higher ranks. Gaining higher ranks means more respect from other criminals and potential victims, which in turn means that more lucrative crimes become available. Shopkeepers are more easily intimidated and therefore more easily robbed or blackmailed. You are also more likely to receive hints about upcoming crimes. After a certain rank has been reached, it is also possible to recruit up to ten gang members which gives you a much better chance in combat against the police or other criminals.

At the beginning of the game, your character is created by randomly determining various statistics: Energy: the character's health, Strength: determines how fast energy is recovered, Intelligence: influences the odds of success of various crimes, Brutality: determines what kind of weapon a character can use.

The game is turn-based. One turn takes one month and at every turn you can take a certain amount of steps, depending on your method of transportation. Most of the game is spent walking around the town entering buildings where actions can be chosen from various multiple choice menus:

Stores: Try to blackmail or rob the store. The lower your rank, the higher the chance that the owner calls the police. If you try to blackmail someone who is already "protected" by another gangster, his gang might attack you.
Bars: Buy or sell alcohol, recruit gang members, get hints about upcoming crimes, get a job as a croupier, bouncer or assassin.
Weapon Stores: Buy weapons, train gang members (increase intelligence or brutality)
Car Dealers: Buy or steal a car. Trying to steal a car is risky, but may be rewarded with especially fast cars that cannot be bought.
Banks: Rob a bank (this requires another gang-member), sneak into the bank and break into the safe (breaking into a safe starts a mini-game).
"Blüten-Eddie": Buy false money (Blüten) or get a fake ID, which decreases the chances of getting busted during police checks.
Underground Stations: Pickpocket people at the station or inside the subway car.
Train-stations: Pickpocket people or try to rob the train.
Casinos: Play Black Jack, Poker or Roulette. You cannot actually play these games, you simply receive the results, which are influenced by your intelligence.
Loan Shark: Lend money or start your own loan shark business.
Police Station: Turn yourself in, bust out another criminal for a reward (only in multiplayer mode) or bribe the chief of police to avoid prosecution.

When fighting the police, other gangs or trying to assassinate somebody, the game enters combat mode. Combat is turn-based and seen from a top-down perspective. During each turn you can either move your character(s) by one field or attack.

210607.overview: MazezaM is a puzzle game, where the player must guide his character through a mazealike room to the exit, by sliding the walls. The rules seems simple and easy to solve, but once the player passes the first levels, he finds himself in a much harder situations. The motivation to go on and see the next levels is still going on at the harder levels, making the game fun for long hours. Sometime it can take hours just to pass a single level. The puzzle game MazezaM for Commodore 64 was developed soon after the Apple II version of the game was finished. The Commodore 64 have a 6502 compatible processor, like the Apple 2, so the gamecode was not hard to translate. Unlike the Apple II, the C64 have graphic and sound coprocessors, which I utilized when transferring the game to Commodore machine. This took extra efforts, but finally at the beginning of year 2004, the game was ready for first public release. Only some hours after I published the C64 version of the game, cracked pirate version was uploaded to some C64 servers, with intro and trainer. Later, second crack by other group appeared. It proved to be quite popular among the C64 gamers, being reviewed in a magazine and web sites.

210664.overview: Mad Monkey is a Frogger clone, but instead of a frog, you play a monkey who needs to cross to the top of the screen. The game was developed by Ewald Mack and published in Input 64 1986/08. An Italian version was also released by Editions Fermont s.r.l. in Nova Games 02.

210666.overview:
Guide Manky through each level collecting keys, eggs and grain. Avoid chicks and other nasties and don't fall off the platforms. Collect all keys and six or more eggs. To get more points, collect grain only if Manky's skin is white.  
 
When the toilet wall is open, guide Manky to the toilet then sit on it to move on to the next level. You must make it before the time runs out. Good luck!

211252.overview: Metal Wars features bitmap scrolling, and looks really nice and detailed in this SEU. A lot like the graphical qualities of IO by Doug and Bob.

211314.overview: Matteo's Land is a ROM hack of The Great Giana Sisters with modified graphics/levels from 2017. This hack was done by Mbign2017. The game itself pretty much plays like the original, except some of the enemy sprites were altered.

213313.overview:
You are Marble Boy and you need to collect 45 pennants/banners in a given order and time. Watch out for holes, work on your maneuvering skills and learn to take shortcuts to save valuable seconds. Are you swift enough to reach the finishing line? General moving also collects points. When competing with your friends then finding the perfect path and flow will make all the difference in the end score.

Trivia: This game is an homage to two of my favourite arcade games: Marble Madness where you control a marble and play on a checkered background and Buggy Boy, where you pick up flags to make points. Hence the name "Marble Boy". Recognition effect is intended but otherwise the game, graphic and sound is all made from scratch and offers its own unique gameplay experience. Have a great marble run! Use minus key to slow your ball\level of difficulty.

Released as part of the 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

215700.overview:
Teacher Mavis Beacon enlists you in class to learn the touch typing. The lessons are explained on chalkboard, and you have to type the proposed words with the certain set of keys by typing them with proper fingers. The keyboard and fingers are shown, as well as the text rows necessary to be typed and typed by you. The first lesson begins with "ASDF" keys of Standard QWERTY keyboard, but the Dvorak keyboard is also supported and may be adjusted before the gameplay.

Also in the game, the Arcade Racing is present. You should type the scrolling text as fast as possible to win a race with drivers of different skills. The skills of drivers and speed of typing are increased from level to level.

Progress Graphing is present to show your progress with over 20 graphs of different parameters. You may use this information to create your own lessons.

The multiple settings of gameplay may be adjusted, your actions and types of games may be explained by help and Mavis` comments, and your progress is saved.

216114.overview:
Learn Morse code with this game by Vince Apps and from the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64", published in 1984. If you are planning to become a sea captain or a pilot then this is the game for you. Even if you are just planning to help your parents on a yachting weekend you will be able to show off with this one.
There is plenty of fun here as well as you can set your own speed of reply to the computer; set your own messages; ask other people to translate what you have sent. The computer will put up on the screen a menu which is a list of items from which you can make a choice. Menu is
1 . Send a message
2. Random letters
3. Words
4. A to Z in Morse

The computer will ask you to choose from 1 , 2, 3 or 4. You will then be asked to choose a speed which you would like from 1 to 100. As 100 is for professional morse code operators we suggest you start at 10. Type in 10 and press RETURN. The computer will then ask you for your message .
If you have chosen 1 you could type in MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU, remembering to use capitals, press RETURN and the computer will play the message back to you in morse code. When the message is complete the computer will return to the menu and ask you for your next choice.
No. 2 will mean that the computer will put random letters on the screen whilst sounding them at the same time. If you choose No. 3, words, the computer will sound out a word, at the speed you choose, which you must identify. When the computer completes the word it will ask you to type in the answer. If you are right - well done. If you are wrong however you will hear a nasty ‘raspberry’ and the computer will show you the correct answer before moving to another word. Remember that your knowledge of morse code could save lives.

216235.overview: A Mahjong solitaire game developed by John V. Ryan and released as a type-in game in RUN 1992/01-02. Not to be confused with the Markt & Technik game of the same name, which was released shortly after this. Call for take-out! This ancient Chinese game of skill promises late hours of addictive fun. I clench my eyes to ease the stinging dryness. Alter a moment's pause I turn back to my 64, mind racing. With a burning stare I review the board: There was another nine somewhere. Did I take it already? There! It's blocked by a three — where's the other deuce? Got it! Back to the nines and I've opened up the whole row. I know the matches, remember where they are — move quickly for max points — clear the board — record your score!

216236.overview: Mazeman is a public domain miscellaneous action game developed by Steve Robinson using Garry Kitchen's Gamemaker. The year of release is unknown.

216239.overview: Made in France II is a Breakout/Arkanois clone for the Commodore 64. it was developed by Jeff Minter and published in The Zzap! Sampler (Zzap! 64  06/1987). The game is a simple two player Breakout clone where the bricks are in the centre and behind each player. The player's bats are at the upper and lower half of the screen. If a player lets the ball leave the screen, the round is lost.

216240.overview: An action game created by OneButtonSmashers and released for Christmas 2019. You are a small magnetic ball, speeding across a magnetic surface the only world you know. Sadly your world is crumbling and the Magnetic bricks that make up the surface beneath you are dropping into the void. As long as a reasonable part of your ball is still touching a brick, the Magnetic field stops you from falling into that limitless void. How many

216241.overview:
An African card game written in BASIC. Matatu is a card game widely played in Uganda, with slightly varying rules. The word "matatu" means a "mix of everything", and is also phonetic for the sound when shuffling. The word matatu (for Swahili "for three" most probably after the standard price  
of 3 Shillings per ride) is used for minibus taxis as well, which provide the main means of transport for people in most of East Africa.  
 
Each player gets 7 cards; goal of the game is to shed all your cards first. You always have to follow either suit or rank, with exception of the Ace (more on that below) - you might decide to draw a card instead though (as you have to if you can't serve), for tactical reasons. But you can also finish the game by "cutting": the first card on the stack is deciding the cut suit, and whoever has the 7 of that suit can finish the game, if there are less or equal than 25 points on his hand. Then the one with less points wins, so the number of cards is not necessarily a reliable indicator. For cutting, you need to know the value of the cards, which are 3 to 10 for the respective ranks, 11 for Jack, 12 for Queen, 13 for King, 15 for Ace and 20 for 2.                                  
2, 8, Jack and Ace have special functions: 8 and Jack allow/force you to play another card (or draw if you can't) unless they are the very last card, and 
the game is finished afterwards. The 2 forces your opponent to draw 2 cards, unless he has also a 2, in which case you will have to draw 4! The Ace can be played on any other card (except the 2), and allows you to request a suit of your choice. There are a few differences to the original card game as it is played in Uganda. If the drawing stack gets finished, the shedding stack is shuffled again (except the topmost card) and used as new drawing stack. Also, the first card (deciding the cut suit) is not used as first card on the  shedding stack, but is normally put sideways under the drawing stack, so that it is visible during the game at all times. And usually the player is still allowed to play after picking a card (except after a 2).   
But as with many card games, there are variations anyway. After all, a great and entertaining game has emerged; my sincere thanks to everybody involved, whom I nagged with constant bug reports and suggestions!

216242.overview:
Metalmaze is a maze escape game for the Commodore 64 computer. It was developed by C.E. Prince and published in the following:

Loadstar #146 + Loadstar #147 + Loadstar #149

216244.overview: An educational, single player math game released for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition and published by Reset Magazine in 2020.

216247.overview: A multi-directional shooter for 2 players created by Arts of Darkness and released in GO64! 2000/10.

216249.overview: A SEUCK based Shoot'em Up for one or two players, including cooperative play. It was released by Outlaw-Emix Software in 1991.

216252.overview: You must get from the bottom to the top of the screen while avoiding the hidden mines. You cannot see the mines but the number of mines adjacent to your position is shown in the top left. Bonus points awarded the quicker you complete the level. There are nine random levels to complete.

216255.overview: Monkey Match is a 2 player only memory game. It was developed by Anthony Rose and published in Loadstar #169.

216259.overview: A game by Raiders of the Lost Empire, released in 2017. In this little roleplaying-game the main character got arrested in the year 1984 by some dark, evil forces. Help him/her to find the exit. The first player who can find the exit will be the most popular commodore 64 hero forever! If you have found the exit, post the name of the main-character as they will tell you then.

216260.overview: An action game by Marcel Sásik released to PD in 1995. The aim of the game is to find your way through the labyrinth. You must do so very carefully as traps and spikes will kill you if your timing isn't just right.

216262.overview:
Happy times. Sad times. Thank you times. I am sorry times. These are just some of the times when people find ways to say "I Love You." Now, with the aid of this creative design activity, Mister Rogers provides children and adults with new opportunities to express themselves to the people they care about.

MANY WAYS TO SAY I LOVE YOU presents a playful setting in which children and their families create their own electronic greeting cards. It includes a selection of backgrounds and borders, dozens of "stickers" to choose from, including characters from the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, and colorful electronic crayons for creating original designs. You can personalize your card with word messages and add Mister Rogers' Neighborhood songs and other favorite childhood tunes. When you're finished, along comes the Neighborhood Trolley to prepare your card for an animated on-screen delivery!

216266.overview: Murder in the Museum is a text adventure written by Fender Tucker in 1987 and published in Loadstar #44.

216291.overview: Moon Base is a simple arcade game that you play with two buttons; one you use to jump over the obstacles while the other is used to fire missiles towards your enemy. Created by Robert Alonso and published in Commodore Microcomputers Magazine 1986/09-10, and also in Loadstar #028.

216491.overview:
In this game by Paul Kubiszyn and published in Commodore Scene #15. You take control of a ship at the bottom of the screen. You control it, using a joystick in port 2. Pressing the fire button, will launch a bullet up the screen. The idea of each level is to rid the screen of menacing balls, or molecules. To do this you must hit each molecule a number of times, until finally it disappears. When the screen is empty, you will progress onto the next level.
Some times you will encounter a token, which will disappear after only 1 hit. The effects of a token last until you lose a life, of which you have 3. After 5 levels, you will also encounter a mini-boss called Big Legs. This creature will take an increasing number of hits to kill.

216745.overview: Maze Eater is a 2020 re-make of the same Maze Eater that was part of the notorious Cassette 50 compilation. It was developed by Richard J. Gibbs and Mark S., and was released into the public domain in 2020.

216826.overview: A single player action game from the imagination of Jamie Fuller's 6-year-old daughter. Released as part of the Reset64 Magazine 2018 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition.

218036.overview: Metallic Legend is a single-player side scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64, in which you control a gaint robot/mech who has to wipe out hordes of nasties as you cross the screen. The game was develped by Erkan and Serkan Dogan and released in 1994 to the public domain.

218149.overview: An action game for one or two players by Ronny Nordqvist & Johan Janssen with music by Daniel Strandberg, together known as Software of Sweden, created for the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2012. Help the little monkey to eat his milk as fast as he can.  By wiggling the joystick left and right you eat the milk. Don't forget to belch with the joystick up when necessary or something bad may happen. Best times saved to disk!

218171.overview:
The Martian Monsters is a space shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by James C. Hilty and published as a type-in game in a Ahoy! 1986/01 (Issue #25).

Shoot the monsters before they eat you. The monsters do not shoot themselves, as their goal is to feed on your spaceship. Good luck!

The game itself was finished in 1985, but not officially released until January of '86.

218221.overview:
Race against the clock to escape from the convoluted dungeons of the rainbow zebra.

This little snack game was build to showcase a grid based ray-casting routine written with the Oscar C compiler.

Eight different labyrinth creating routines provide 27 levels of increasing size and complexity.  Use the joystick direction control to navigate, and the button to accelerate.  A preview of the maze is shown before each race and can be inspected using the left and right joystick control.  The STOP button opens a small in game menu.

218265.overview: The basic concept is that you're flying a spaceship, and 1 or 2 missiles launch and try to bring you down. You can select the thrust force of the missiles, as well as how much fuel (time) they have before they fall out of the sky. In 2 player mode, player 2 controls the missile. At the beginning, your ship will be stationary at the bottom centre of the screen. Turning the ship is disabled, you can only thrust straight up. Once you get a bit of altitude, you'll be able to turn, and the missile(s) will launch. Evade the missile(s) until their fuel runs out and they fall to the ground and explode.

218267.overview:
Dive into the ocean and guide the mollusk through many levels of excitement in this C64 exclusive underwater eat 'em up!
Originally entered in RGCD's 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition (2011), this was later followed with a special redux version with additional features.

218457.overview:
A shooter by Rasmus Wernersson, created using the Shoot'em Up Construction Kit and released in 1992 in 64'er Sonderheft 85. A shoot'em up adventure in the middle ages. In the Dark Ages:Walbur wanders through a surreal landscape. His friends were turned into undead by the evil powers from the magic castle. You must help! 
 
The twilight casts dark shadows. I grope forward with hesitant steps. can i help my friends The old magician Menlir had explained with a sad expression that they had set out through the Barrens to the burial ground in order to reach the magic castle via the caves of blood. There, he murmured with bowed head, the fate of all invaders met her - the eerie walls banished her spirit into the lifeless shell of the undead. "But," he whispered mysteriously to me, eyes glittering, "there's a magic weapon you can use to turn them back." And furtively he handed me a small crossbow: "It doesn't need to be reloaded."

And the wise druid gave me another piece of advice: Collect the mysterious coins by the wayside. They give you life energy. And now I cross quietly, carefully, the dreary fallow land. Always on the lookout for dangerous, wildly scurrying figures - the magic weapon in your hand. Past craggy rocks where aggressive, immortal trolls are up to mischief. Who knows what dangers still await me. Hopefully I can save my friends...

218931.overview:
Note:

This game works perfectly on both PAL and NTSC models. However, the game was developed and tested on an NTSC model, so it is suggested using the latter.


Gameplay:

The game is set inside a spaceship invaded by alien entities that have deactivated the supply batteries necessary for the propulsion of the rockets.
The aim is to guide Mike, the mechanic on board, inside the various power rooms and reactivate the batteries. To activate a battery, the player simply has to touch it on one of the four sides.

The player has the option of moving around the rooms by jumping from battery to battery or by using elevators that move vertically or horizontally. Sometimes there are portals through which the player can teleport to another point in the room.

Mike has no defense against aliens. The only way to complete a level is therefore to avoid them not to lose a life. Even the contact with the cooling fans, present in some rooms, is fatal.

To complicate matters there is a time limit, beyond which the player will lose a life.

After activating a certain number of batteries, a crystal will appear for approximately 10 seconds. The player can try to pick it up to increase the score.
Once all the batteries in a room have been activated, the player will earn an extra score based on the amount of time left and will go to the next level.

Every 10000 points the player earns an extra life, for a maximum of 8 lives.


Options:

The game includes 70 levels in total. By choosing Ship Layout A, you will play the easiest 35 levels. By choosing Layout B, you will play the 35 most difficult levels. By choosing Layout A+B, you will play all 70 levels.


Controls:

Joystick left/right = Move Mike
Fire button = Jump
Joystick down = Teleport

While playing, press F7 to pause or F1 to stop the game and go back to the title.

While the best scores are showing, press F1 to reset the ranking.

219155.overview:
Gaetano Chiummo won the 2010 Vertical scrolling SEUCK compo with this entry. In the land of Noworries, Teodius the Archmage was practicing his spells on nature. Unfortunately his practice made a huge impact on the untroubled land. Therefore, all good living creatures transformed into mutants. Teodius read the spell book to find out how to break the spell which he should not have done in the first place. The only way to break the spell was if another mage had turned the responsible person into a living amphibian (Okay, so it's a friendly green frog). Teodius was terrified and went into hiding.
Meanwhile on the other side of the land of Noworries, lived another mage, called Durmion. After he heard a flash and bang, he found that all the nice living creatures and nature were really mean. So he heads off with his magic wand to find Teodius and break the spell. The game. Help Durmion transform mutants into nice living things again and seek out Teodius in his hideout. During your journey you can pick up the plants and mix them into the cauldron to gain better ability to fight your way to the end.

219213.overview: A one or two player adaptation of Clue in Italian programmed by E. Gervino and published by Systems Editoriale s.r.l. in Commodore 64 Club #05 [Italian Release] in 1988 and also in Alga Soft 1988 n.14b. Find out if it was Mr. Green in the bar with the razor or Mr. Red in the Bedroom with the scissors.

219549.overview:
The first game in the 'Meurtres' ('Murders') series by Bertrand Brocard - out of five - and published in French only.

The events take place aboard a TGV train - France's high-speed rail transport running between Paris and Lyon. A high-ranking senator Albert Pérignac is found dead in one of the railway wagons - and as a private detective who happened to be onboard as well, we are entitled to solve the mystery before the train reaches its destination. Was it an accident, a suicide - or a murder, perhaps a political one?

The graphics are very simple: in the upper left section of the screen we see a schematic layout of a railway car we are currently in, viewed top down, with our protagonist being indicated by an 'X'; below appears a text description, and to the right - portraits of a few passengers and staff members we are able to speak to. As with other games in 'Murders' series, the major feature of this mystery game is a collection of 'feelies' included: there is a dozen of 'clues' - mostly different notes and pieces of paper - that are to be studied 'in real life' when found in the game in their virtual form.

219787.overview: Magical Girl Mary 2, More Fun, More Sprites, New Level Map, New Level Graphics, Title Screen, Title Screen Music, Hi-Score Table, Same Old School Game Play.

219808.overview: How far into December can you keep this job? Can you make it all the way to the 25th and save Christmas, or is it back to the kitchen for ol' Mike...?

219847.overview: Mini Don is a cool Don Doko Don conversion which was being done as part of a mini-game compo.

219866.overview:
Magical Girl Mary Vs E.V.I.L., Use a Joystick in Port 2 to move Mary and Fire Button to Shoot, This is a Push Scroll Game so moving forward will scroll the screen and you can only fire forward, Also 1 Player Only Game, Have Fun.

Made with help from the Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Using my modified SEUCK Enhancement Framework Code, Original Framework code by Richard Bayliss of TND, Music by Andrew Fisher

219872.overview: This is a two player strategy game. Each player takes turns and, using a joystick, must shift a colored stone. The object is to get four stones of your color in a row, horizontally or vertically. In the Commodore 64 version, this will win you the game. In the Atari 2600 version, this will damage your opponent. If your opponent loses all energy, you win. You can move any stone, no matter what it's color. This means you could damage yourself or lose yourself the game. Once a stone has been moved, that move cannot be reversed.

220000.overview:
The Machinations is an automation puzzle game for Commodore 64.
Transport the binary cell from the source to the target using the modules at your disposal. The game is a remake of The Sequence by One Man Band.
The game contains 6 module types and 40 levels, including a sandbox level.

220035.overview:
SEUCK Game Creation Compo 2016

The first entry for the Back to Basics category (Basically, a normal SEUCK / Sideways scrolling SEUCK, without any additional enhancements added to the game, itself. This is an amusing little game, which puts your player in the middle of a Bull-Fighting arena, but unlike many bull fights, there are a few surprises on the way. The game is quite nicely detailed, and acts as if you are on different Spanish TV channels of  the 1980's. Music on the title screen is called "Olé Hosé', which I composed today using DMC V4.0. A legendary great music composing tool, written in the early 1990's by Graffity.

220096.overview:
1 Player Avoid Traps Game, Run around the maze like Game and try to avoid all traps, Pick up Gold Coins for Bonus Points, Check the Video to see the game in action.

2 Downloads to Pick from, One is the Normal Game with 3 Lives and the Other is the Cheat Mode Game with infinite lives.

220107.overview: A one or two player matching memory game created by Troy McBain and published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1993/03.

220131.overview:
The Mystery of Markham Manor is the third game in the Sam Boon series and the second in the Murder, Mystery, and Suspenders prequel to The Dragnet Case. You are Sam Boon, a Private Investigator, the date is June 1st, 1973 a few years after your first case A Case Of Murder. Lord Markham of Markham Manor, England has contacted you to solve the mysterious haunting by his late wife Lady Mary Markham.  

Robert Powell has joined you as a sidekick eager for an adventure. He has been useful in the past with an extensive knowledge of poisons and fluency in several ancient languages.

The PanAm flight from America lands in the pouring rain at Heathrow where a car picks you up. After a long drive, you arrive a Markham Hall where the driver leaves you to continue.

242952.overview: A Minesweeper clone for the C64 created by Robert B. Cook and published in 1993 in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1993/06.

295680.overview:
Despite its name, Megatron is not a reference to the leader of the Decepticons in the Transformers series, rather it's a Tron Light Cycles game for 1-2 players. 

It was developed by Technische Maschinenfabrik and released into the public domain in 2015.

317366.overview:
There are two dead safe methods to survive a nuclear attack with ICBMs.  Defence with anti missiles and "Duck and Cover" where a simple desk will defy a multi megaton nuke.  Your mission is to protect the six major cities against the global nuclear attack, else perish with them. 
 
You control three anti ICBM missile launch sites,  if you run out of missiles or launch sites or the enemy missiles you are out of luck until the end of the stage.

417980.overview: A one player arcade style game by Jon Williams & Dávid Vigh, released to PD in 2020. This was the second game in the Berks trilogy, released originally in 1985 for the Vic20 and converted to C64 by Digital Monastery. A cross between a painter program where you have to pass by sections of the gamescreen to lock them in and with shooter elements.

418717.overview:
Monkey see, Monkey Spell is a 1-player educational game for multiple systems.

The player controls a large monkey who can climb a tree and collect letters off of the branches. Pictures appear at the base of the tree, and the player has a limited time to climb the tree and find the needed letters to spell the word. The player receives a score based upon the word spelled.

418718.overview:
Monkey Kong is an attempt at making a Donkey Kong clone using BASIC. It was developed by Todd Harrison & Les Battyanyi and published in the 1984 book "Giant Book of Games for Your Commodore 64".

The game is keyboard controlled only.

419239.overview: Mary Mary.... is an educational spelling/reading game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Alexander Leslie Software in 1984.

419519.overview:
Liberate the land from the evil Murdlok! Reflection, not recklessness will guide you to your goal!

Murdlok is a previously unreleased graphical text-based adventure game for the Commodore 64 written in 1986 by Peter Hempel. A German and an English version exist.
It was translated in 2018 into English by Lisa Brodner and Michael Steil

419682.overview:
Macbeth Quiz is an educational quiz game centered around what is arguably William Shakespeare's most well regarded play. The game was developed and published by Commodore Educational Software in 1983.

Released as part of CBM Public Domain - English II.

419825.overview: The Mummy is a text adventure with charset graphics for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by Stephan Swertvaegher and released into the public domain in 1990.

420281.overview:
Misty Island is a standard text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Dorothy Millard and published by The Adventure Workshop in 1994.

Story:

You know too much, and have been unceremoniously dumped semiconscious on a remote misty island, with no food, to die. Of course this doesn't appeal to you, dying, that is!

Can you find a way to survive this nightmare, and even escape back to civilization?

In your semiconscious state, you hear spies whispering about "hiding the evidence". The men leave you to regain consciousness. Now it's up to you.

420282.overview: Mixed Colors is a single-player brainteaster/puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Stefan Bisitz and released at Willow Party 2007.

420283.overview: MKII is a science fiction themed Spanish language selectable answers text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Los Burros del Soft and released into the public domain in 2011.

420285.overview: Mixed World for the Commodore 64 is a 1-player vertically scrolling shooter created by Shaun Pearson using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit. The year of release is unknown.

421121.overview: Retro Gaming with Jeffery is working on an interesting multi-party game that just might be the star of everyone's show once it comes out. This one's called Mega Wizards. Jeffrey's brother sent him a charpad design for a Warlords type of game for C64 and J van der Schilden has been working on it now and then.

421629.overview: Musery is a musical memory game for the C64. it was developed by Markus Rath and published in 64'er 1990/03. a thinking game for two people, similar to the well-known “Memory” game. However, the players do not have to uncover pairs of pictures, but rather fields with the same sound sequences. For each revealed pair, 250 points and a time bonus are awarded.

422010.overview: Mad Monkeys: Are Coming Your Way! is an educational math game developed by Canadian coder Ian Adam and published in UpTime Vol.1 #09. The goal of the game is to answer math problems to help the monkeys get the coconuts from the tree.

422012.overview:
Not to be confused with Monkey Kong from Fontana Paperbacks, Monkey-Kong (which is also a DK clone) is a French language platformer. It was developed by Emerich Fernandes and published in the following:

•   Hebdogiciel N°126 (14.03.1986)
•   Hebdogiciel N°127 (21.03.1986)

422077.overview:
Mines64 is a Commodore 64 game developed by Frabrizio Caruso for the 2019 BASIC 10liner Contest.

Move your character (the cyan circle)  and avoid the white ones, and collecting the dollar signs. There is no title screen, the game goes straight into the gameplay. Keyboard controlled only.

Controls:

i = up
j = left
L = right
k = down

422163.overview: Manky Maze (not to be confused with the game called Manky) is a simple maze game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Sado Masochism Software and released as part of the Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2001 (C64CGC).

422338.overview: Miner! is a gold mine simulator where your goal is to mine as much gold as possible with your 15 charges of dynamite without blowing your equipment up.

424234.overview: Mediterranean Air War (MAW) is a game for the Commodore 64. It has been made using SEUCK with some small code modifications. The game certainly does not stack up to the maximum capabilities of either the Commodore 64 or even a modified SEUCK for that matter, but it is a project which still bares all the love and personal attention that I could muster.

424334.overview: Meteor Shower is a simple little game for the beloved C64. Repel as many meteors as possible, without breaching the hull. Once the time is up, hurry inside for a breather. And then it’s onto the next barrage!

425277.overview: A single player sequel to the original Meta Snake game, also by Anders Lundh with additional graphics and fonts by Zerozillion released as PD in 2009. Use either joystick or keyboard controls.

425314.overview: Mrs. Rockford Dash a a game made by Prof. Knibble using the Boulder Dash Construction Kit. It takes the main character and turns him into a female character. It was released in 1991.

425451.overview: MOOD was an extremely promising and technically impressive Wolfenstein/Doom clone for the C64 from 1996-1998 , running on stock hardware without any enhancements.

425453.overview: Tiny platform game with a level editor ( because I was told it couldn't be done ) get the key, open the door. 4 levels in. there are 4 additional level slots for you to edit and play.

425455.overview: Mini Danmaku 64, a bullet hell shooter by Cogitare Computing. Released 30 June 2020; 16th in the C64 4kb Game Coding Competition 2020 4k game competition.

425469.overview: An action jumping game from Matthias Pohl released as part of the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. Press S to make the blue runner jump and L to make the red runner jump. Keep them jumping and go as far as you can.

425481.overview:
Morubotto

An amalgamation of the Japanese words morumotto (guinea pig) and robotto (robot).

Dangerous, radioactive, exploding asteroids are descending upon earth.

Only Morumotto can save us!

Morubotto is a variation of missile command where instead of controlling crosshairs you control a robotic guinea pig and have to bounce around the level and try to collide with as many asteroids as possible to minimize the amount of damage that the asteroids do to the world.

Written for the Reset64 Craptastic 4K game competition , the game is 4090 bytes in size.

425493.overview:
Some legends are lost in the depths of time, and Mimizuku's story could have been one of them...
One day, your dead ancestors wished to get back to life so they called you to come down to Yomi, the realm of the dead. The underworld. 
They can't escape the underworld by themselves - you need to come and lead them out.

425500.overview:
Magic 6 is a numerical puzzle game for the Commodore 64. The goal of the game is to get all the columns, rows, and diagonals to add up to 111. You can also swap numbers during the game. 

The game was developed by Knees Calhoon and published in Loadstar #166 in 1998.

425541.overview:
Maniac Mansion + Zak McKracken released for Easyflash on C64.  
This version includes:
- 2 savegames directly to Easyflash for each game
- the complete original docs on both
- simple, but helpful cheats
- cool SID covers from Conrad :)
- savegame management to dump stored savegames to disk or restore them.

German version available as well...

439985.overview:
Man Catch a Pea is a simple game for the Commodore 64, in which you play a yellow character inside a maze and have to catch a green pea.

The game was developed by Stefan Saalfeld and relased into the public domain in originally in 1986, but was updated with changes in 1988.

443875.overview:
Metal Piramid (and yes, that is the spelling as shown in the game) is a neat platformer which was developed back in the early 1990s by Attila Deák, who would eventually go on to working at Novatrade and on Ecco the Dolphin 2.

The game is a neat little platformer, which reminds me a bit of Hard n Heavy, where you must collect items, avoid/kill enemies and get to the exit. Overall, there are 10 levels to navigate, with an end sequence, so it seems to be complete.

Music was created by Zoltán Nagy (and is tucked away in the game), though the title and game tune is by Neil Baldwin. Seems that the music was temporary and Zoltán’s music was not fully utilized, even though it is there and is being ripped for HVSC.

Richard Bayliss kindly has made a version which uses Zoltán’s music as intended.

445038.overview: There is a severe lack of vertical split screen scrolling games on the C64. But don’t despair, “Metal Mayhem” is out to remedy the situation by delivering an old school one on one tank game. You can play against a friend or your less friendly computer.

446692.overview: Missione Lunare is a simple game written in BASIC V2.0 for Commodore 64 inspired by Lunar Lander and Jupiter Lander.

447519.overview: Moon Raider is a 1-player public domain clone of Konami's arcade classic, Scramble, for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Russell Wallace and published in both Digital Marketing PD #055 and Stonysoft #0419.

449820.overview:
The  Meteor  Mining  Company  is hiring  pilots  to  fly  a  fleet  of  ships for  collecting  asteroids  in  outer space.  It  has  devised  a  test  to  discover people  who  have  the  necessary  talents  to  pilot  a  spaceship  while  simultaneously solving  problems  to  decide which  asteroids  are  valuable. 

The  object  of  Meteor  Math  is  to collect  correct  answers  to  simple  math problems  while  avoiding  the  incorrect ones.  You'll  be  given  the  first  number in  an  addition  or  multiplication  problem and  its  answer.  It  will  be  your  job to  maneuver  your  ship  through  a  field  of  moving  numbers  to  collect  the  one that  completes  the  problem.

449964.overview: Mineshaft Gap is a real-time strategy game for the C64 where you control up to 32 independent bunker dwellers in their strive for a less radioactive better future.

450988.overview:
Re-live Munchkin, the classical maze-eater (also known as K.C. Munchkin on the Osyssey2 and VideoPac) ported to the legendary 8-bit computer Commodore 64.

Comes packed not only with the original game (including random mazes and maze editor), but also ten user mazes and an arcade version with 96 different levels, 58 mazes and new challenges for Munchkin along the way.

The game comes as either a disk image (.d64) or as a program (.prg). The only difference between them is that the disk version saves high score, edited user mazes and progress on disk.

The game is released free of charge and any donations will be 100 % forwarded to cancer research.

451577.overview:
A German (probably) unlicensed compilation of four games published by Mike & Soft the date of release is late 1989. Included games: 

◉ Artillery Duel
◉  Hat Trick
◉  Paradroid
◉  Punkiller 
 
While the first three games are fairly well known, the last was a 2 player SEUCK game with cooperative play that was previously released commercially only in Italy.

452280.overview: Mikael is out for a run, but mud, pumpkins and other things gets in his way. While he runs in a steady pace, sometimes it is wise to speed up (but keep track of his stamina), other times it is better to slow down but who knows what is lurking behind him? More obstacles appears the further he runs!

452304.overview:
You are a famous android, but your mega-blaster weapon has been stolen by the Malfunctioning Eccentric Tinkerbots (M.E.T.). In this game, your mission is to traverse three levels and reclaim your weapon.
To succeed, you'll need to complete each level twice. Do you have what it takes to reach the end with some energy left?
You can play on "Normal" difficulty or challenge yourself with "Hard" mode. In Hard mode, you'll face additional limitations, making the journey even tougher.

The Levels
Level 1: Navigate through the M.E.T.s while avoiding collisions. You can switch between three horizontal lanes or jump to dodge enemies. Be cautious, though – slow M.E.T.s can’t be jumped over. They’ll still be below you when you land!
Level 2: Dodge falling M.E.T.s by moving left or right as they’re launched by a giant M.E.T.
Level 3: The "Flappy M.E.T.s" challenge. You probably already know what that means.
If you make it to the end, the hero reclaims their weapon and prepares for new adventures, but that’s another story for another time.

453286.overview: Behind this title is a new retro game for c64, inspired by Pac-Man and its many maze muncher clones that we were fortunate to play during the 1980s and 1990s. It also drew inspiration from a number of other old arcade and logic games, as will surely be obvious to seasoned retro gamers.

453436.overview: The Dr. Rallerstein intends to dominate the world with his dangerous robot empire. Your mission is to destroy th eboss robot and his enemy base, good luck!

453808.overview:
The war against the Xarvi is turning to term; the last offensive unleashed by horrifying insects bent the shaky defense
the X-25 galactic quadrant; many human settlements They fell into the hands of the invaders.

The higher council has decreed an immediate counteroffensive to prevent the Xarvi from arriving directly to the central star group, so as to safeguard freedom throughout the galaxy; but Counteroffensive will not take place if the station
Xarva main space located at the center of the sector galactic X-25 will not be disabled until this builds the network of conquest, the last Found in the Neutron War.

That's why a secret agent must infiltrate in the spatial base, identify all codes of access and penetrate the control room, where it can ably disable the computer that Controls the Xarva offensive.

A mass attack would be of no use, Space station is defended by the most aggressive Xarva garrison that uses the fast
Asgerat combatcruit cruisers, capable of Reduce to pieces the largest stellar fleet of the The Confederation of Free Humans. This is why one and A single agent can infiltrate between Xarve files, penetrate the galactic sector X-25 and reach the space station. A complicated lift system allows you to reach the various sections of the Station.

453854.overview:
Welcome to "Make 10 or 50", a challenging puzzle game for the Commodore 64 and Commodore Plus/4 where your goal is to clear numbers from a grid by selecting groups that add up to a specific target sum. Test your math skills and speed as you aim for the highest score within the time limit (120 seconds)!

Game Modes:

    Make 10 Mode: Select groups of numbers that sum up to 10.
    Make 50 Mode: Select groups of numbers that sum up to 50.

Difficulty Levels:

    Easy: Standard gameplay with Arabic numerals.
    Medium: A moderate challenge with Roman Numerals, colors of the numbers are always the same.
    Hard: Binary numbers, colors of numbers are shuffled.

Controls (Joystick in Port 2):

    Up: Move cursor up.
    Down: Move cursor down.
    Left: Move cursor left.
    Right: Move cursor right.
    Fire Button:
        Press once: Start a selection.
        Press again: Finalize the selection

454541.overview:
Not to be confused with the 1993 game of the same name, Minesweeper 64 by Rainbow is also a clone of Minesweeper. 

It was released into the public domain in 2015.

454550.overview: Minesweeper 64 is a Minesweeper clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Erik Engdahl and released into the public domain in 1993.

454885.overview:
An unofficial level editor for the C64 version of Manic Miner (also includes a sample game).

It was developed by Tim, however the exact release date is unknown.

455645.overview: Destroy the ghosts in the maze before they eat all the burgers. The ghosts are invisible unless you have a direct line of sight to them, but you can often work out where they are by watching the food disappear piece by piece.

455799.overview: The game is set inside a cargo spaceship which, during one of the countless journeys to transport minerals to the home planet Gravion, was invaded by alien entities. The aim is to guide Mike, the on-board mechanic, inside the various cargo holds (four in total) and activate all the levers present in them.

455872.overview: An updated version of Boulderdash with added caves to explore and loot! Created by Carl Muller and publshed by ZZap!64. “Mini-Dash” introduces new levels in the style of “Boulder Dash.” Players must once again apply clever strategies to overcome obstacles, collect diamonds, and avoid deadly dangers. The new challenges require precise timing and foresight to successfully complete the levels.

456290.overview:
CONGRATULATIONS ...

You have succeeded on becoming the chosen one on becoming the MAIN NINJA. Training has been successful at the TND Dojo. Now you have a very long journey home. It isn't  going to be all that easy. Luckily for you, you can put your ninja skills to the test.

The object of this game is to guide your ninja safely home, to his bed. The trouble is that you have a long and dangerous journey. You need to climb buildings, fly across landscapes, and even have a good swim. During your journey, you will also encounter some mean enemies, ninjas and other baddies. Luckily for you, you have infinite ninja stars to throw at them. Can you make your way home safely, or will you fall asleep elsewhere? Good luck ninja!


Made using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit.

456610.overview:
2025 SEUCK Compo Entry #5

The year is 2142. The empire of the Megaloryans, a power-hungry alien race, has invaded the galaxy, threatening to destroy all life. You are Pinov Vox, a brave space pilot, commanding the powerful spaceship Mega Vortex 2.

Your mission: penetrate enemy lines, destroy their warships and defeat Lord Megaloryan, the tyrannical leader of the empire.

The battle will be arduous, but you are the last hope for the galaxy!

457336.overview:
Meteor Shower is a simplified keyboard only controlled Asteroids variant/clone for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Peter J. Lear and published as a type-in listing in the book "Getting Ahead: Space Adventures" in 1984.

457409.overview:
Melee is a single-player 2D top-down role-playing game for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed by Cleveland M. Blakemore and published in Loadstar #061 in 1989.

457528.overview: Mr. C is a 1-4 player pinball game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by JAM,  and released in PCS Club Disk #34

457788.overview:
Math Baseball is 1-2 player  educational math game for the Commodore 64.

Solve math problems to advance in this sports themed edutainment game.

The game was developed by Activity Records and published by Daybreak Software in 1983.

457797.overview: Reach the exit of the multi level dungeons to escape. Avoid the enemies or pick up knives to throw at them.

458653.overview:
The Machine is an overhead horizontal scrolling racing game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Bianchi Soft, and published in Software Club N°19.

458758.overview:
Help Mad Moggy (that's british for a crazy cat ;) ) to collect all the required items on each level without falling down or hitting skulls (later levels). Picking up more than one of the same type of item in a row (see the blinking pick up in the score area) will give multiple points.

Once the Moggy has started, it is full speed ahead, until hitting something (or you press the other direction), then  Moggy will reverse and sets off in full speed in the other direction. Like cats do!

459005.overview:
Moon Madness is a 1999 "avoid it" game for the Commodore 64.

The game was developed by Mirage Designs Software and published as a PD game by Binary Zone PD in 1999.

459006.overview: Moon Madness: Episode II is an "avoid it" game for the Commodore 64, and the official sequel to Moon Madness, and with a huge update in terms of graphics over the first game. This was was however developed and released by TND in 2018.

459417.overview: Mystery City - The Fortunate FortuneTeller is a prologue to the previous game Mystery City – The Secret Code. It tells the story of the young detective Thomas Falken, who investigates a fortune teller suspected of fraud at the request of Arthur Hayes, a journalist from the Mystery City Chronicle. But during a séance at her mansion, an unexpected event occurs, changing the course of the investigation.

459440.overview: Mystery City is an interactive fiction, a graphic/text adventure game by Rogerio Biondi picturing the Noir Movie theme

459737.overview: During your research note from an old miner's diary that in an old abandoned mine there is a lump of phantom ore that has left in the mine when it has closed. it is your task noh to 6o beneath again and recover the phantom ore. but behare that the miner also hrote that the mine has haunted by ghosts.

460189.overview: Alas, disaster has struck! Three of the musketeers have been bested by the cardinal's men, and the diamonds have been hidden in secret locations around and below the streets of Paris. You must rescue the three musketeers, find the diamonds and challenge the cardinal!

460707.overview: The player's task is to guide the hero to the door while avoiding contact with walls and the guard that appears. The difficulty lies in the fact that the guard appears in different places completely at random and sometimes appears in the hero's place, taking his life. The game has only 3 levels to complete.

460762.overview: A strategic game for two players. Players place pieces of their colour on the board and try to surround their opponent's pieces. If this manoeuvre is successful, all surrounded pieces are moved to the captured pieces pool. The player who has more of their opponent's captured pieces and creates more single ‘eyes’ on the board wins. If it is impossible to make a move or if the next move may reduce the number of points, the player must place their piece in the PASS field.

460879.overview: The player's task is to paint over all the paths of the grid while avoiding spinning objects. The paint is taken from the purple area, and the player must paint over the grid cells to fill them, thereby increasing the range of the source. Moving too far away from the paint source or moving backwards in the opposite direction will interrupt the painting process. There is only one life in the game, and losing it means starting all over again.

461073.overview: Manic Miner made in BASIC. The main character and enemy creatures have been replaced with characters from PAC-MAN. The player's task is to collect all the keys on the board and reach the exit before the oxygen runs out.

461186.overview: A marble is removed when you jump over it with another marble horizontal or vertical.  To jump, select a marble with the selection ring by pressing fire. Next you  move the joystick in the direction where the marble shall go. The marble will moe only if it can move over one other marble onto an empty field.

464463.overview: Planet Earth is under attack! The mind blowers aliens are trying to erase every knowledge in order to set the world on a primitive state!

464509.overview: A simple tile matching game for the Commodore 64, written in BASIC.

464512.overview: MONSTER SQUAD 64 is a turn-based mini-RPG written entirely in Commodore 64 BASIC. Assemble your team of three monsters and face ten unpredictable events in your journey to seal the gates of the underworld! Every choice counts — send the right creature to each challenge and harness their chaotic traits, special powers, and quirky personalities.

464514.overview: Start with 100 Gold. Buy Ore from Dwarves, Dust from Faeries. Craft Magic Swords in the Smithy

464515.overview: A Commodore 64 memory quest with points, pairs, and pure nostalgia!

464882.overview: This game is a Commodore 64 port of the Commodore PET version made by Hiroshi Suzuki in 1979.

467302.overview:
Mad Motel is an early PD game for the Commodore 64. It is a board game for up to 9 players.

The game was developed and released by Bob Mockford in 1983.

468059.overview: You must guide a hungry millipede around collecting hearts and avoiding obstacles.

468425.overview: Join Marshi and Phoebe, two adventurous guinea pigs with a taste for fruit and danger in this puzzle-platformer adapted from the original Donut 80 game. Explore a series of themed levels including the countryside, a sci-fi laboratory, rugged mountain passes, deep mines, and even a fully armed pirate ship.

470678.overview:
Marlow Dash No 1 is a Boulder Dash game made by Marlow/Lady Di using Jeffrey Schneider's Boulder Dash Construction Kit.

The game was released in 1989.

It was Marlow's only game.

470750.overview: Murder Diaries: Ankara aka MDA, is a game inspired by the pc game of the same name. It was prepared for Commodore 64 in 2024 using the basic language.

470915.overview: The objective of the game is to cross (in one piece) a minefield, from the safety zone at the top of the screen, to the safety zone on the bottom of the screen.

472006.overview: After a decade of conflict between the megacorporations, the battlefields were abandoned — littered with automated war machines still following their last orders. Nobody dared go in. Until now. You are the last licensed Mech pilot, hired to shut it all down. Ten sectors. Every turret, tank, and ghost mech still active. Your call.

472468.overview: A free and fun snake-like game.Eat mushrooms for points and to grow longer. The longer your worm is the more you score. Avoid the walls and your own tail. Eat mushrooms rapidly to increase the score multiplier. Eat stars to shrink your worm. Each new star will take longer to spawn than the previous so make use of them sparingly.

472656.overview: You are a ranged fighter, who has accidentally entered titular Mazes of Malice. The exit is sealed behind you. Your only option is to use all your guile, cunning, and sharpshooting archer skills to sneak your way to the bottom of the Mazes, where you can find the magical artifact which can send you home.

474148.overview: Mr. Do!, that king of arcade clowns, is in a bit of a bind - again! This time, a pack of pesky unicorns is trampling the bricked hallways of his castle. Help Mr. Do! rid his dwelling of these crafty, quick-changing (and deadly) creatures with the skillful swing of a hammer. Sometimes a quick clobber to the head will do it. Or maybe a well chosen brick knocked out from above. If you can't stop these critters, then break a hole in the floor to slow 'em down. It's up to you to know when to fight - or when to flee! Tension mounts as you hurry Mr. Do! through the castle's maze, grabbing keys along the way. Only when Mr. Do! has collected all the keys can he unlock the castle door, and open up an extra chance to beat these nasty critters!

475932.overview: Moria8 is a port of the classic roguelike game, Moria, for 8-bit platforms written in platform-specific assembly.

476095.overview: In Minecave you are trying to find the most valuable ore; the red diamond. To reach it you need to mine other ores, sell them at the store to upgrade your tool. Each tool upgrade gives you access to a lower ground level.

476097.overview: A 6502 assembly TMS1100 interpreter that runs the original Merlin MP3404 ROM on a Commodore 64.

476827.overview: Monaco Racer C64 is a small Commodore 64 racing experiment written in Assembly 6502.

478530.overview: Your goal is to accumulate as much wealth as possible in gold and diamonds. Every time you dig, you'll pay a cost! Watch out for moving rocks! When you've collected enough gold to move on to the new mine, the border will turn green; otherwise, it will be red. Each mine has a time limit, and as you level up, the target value and the player's speed will increase! Use E to exit and spacebar to dig! Have fun!

478541.overview: Moon Bingo is an educational software title from Grolier / Mindflight that was recently recovered from long-term archival loss in August 2026

479289.overview: Methane Mayhem is a puzzle game written in BASIC where you have to complete a connection between two points using random pipe sections. It's turn based with a time limit. The left side of the screen contains a timer. The time will start full and drop on each turn. Once at the bottom it will start to rise again. Reaching back to the top will fail the level. The timer initially represents the time until the pipe start to leak, and then how much has leaked as it rises.

479316.overview: Motorbike Madness views downhill racing from an isometric Marble Madness-influenced perspective. You must reach the bottom within the time limit, remaining within the track boundaries and avoiding hazards including water, logs and stationary cars. The faster you complete the course, the more prize money you receive. Repairs to any damage to the bike (incurred by contact with the aforementioned hazards) must be paid for from this, but the rest can be spent on upgrades. The controls are rotational, with the fire button or space used for wheelies

480256.overview: Monday is a simple text adventure typed/programmed on a real Commodore 64

480257.overview: Make sure your rocket reaches orbit!

480261.overview: Minitris is NOT a Tetris clone. There are no tetrominoes, no rotations, and no clearing by filling rows.

480273.overview: A Hungarian BoulderDash game with a mushroom theme created by Zoltán Scserbin in 2002. There are 30 games in this series.

480355.overview: Inside the Commodore 64 motherboard a battle rages. Its up to you to reset the system motherboard. Do it enough times and you can escape. POKEs will attempt to steal your life. Shoot them to claim a zero or a one which is used in the PEEK code you will need to set the system memory correctly to perform the reset.

480365.overview: A BoulderDash game with a heavy mushroom theme, created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin in 2002.

480387.overview: A BoulderDash game with a heavy mushroom theme, created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin in 2002. This game is one of 30 in the series.

480429.overview: The Kingdom of Eldrun has been invaded by the demon Zarboz and his minions. Many heroes have tried to vanquish the demon, but none has succeeded. You are the next to try, as a mighty warrior, brave hunter, or cunning wizard.

480480.overview: A BoulderDash game, one of 30 in this series of games, with a heavy mushroom theme, created by Hungarian Zoltán Scserbin in 2002.

480481.overview: A Hungarian BoulderDash game with a mushroom theme created by Zoltán Scserbin in 2002. There are 30 games in this series, this is the final one.

480503.overview: A Hungarian BoulderDash game with a mushroom theme created by Zoltán Scserbin in 2002. There are 30 games in this series.

480540.overview: The computer generates a random band name for Mel, and scatters the letters across the screen. Your task is to collect the letters in order, to progress to the next level. The new name is one letter longer on each level.

480760.overview:
The Pharaohs have always protected the Earth from their retreat in the land of "Ankh." Alas, Mikrom—the last Pharaoh—seeks to transcend existence by destroying the universe. Research by scientists across various galaxies has led to the creation of two starships equipped with new lasers capable of disintegrating the entire arsenal of the "Mikrom World." The fate of the universe rests in your hands!   
 
A vertically scrolling SEUCK based shooter made by Bebop of the French DXCH.

481187.overview: Mr Shit Strikes Back is a 1-2 player co-operative shooter for the Commodore 64, and the sequel to Mr Shit's Space War. It was developed by Ulf Tidstrand, Andreas Sjöberg & Mattias Blanck using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and published in 1990 on SYS PD SPD-Disk #2 (only shortly after the first game).

481190.overview: Mr Shit's Space War is a 1-2 player (co-operative) shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Ulf Tidstand and Mattias Blanck using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and released as part of SYS PD SPD-Disk #1 in 1990.

481346.overview:
The council's survey plan is from 1953 and some of the manhole covers have gone. Walk the field and count.
Every square you stand on is surveyed. The number on a square is how many open drains touch it, corners included. Do not stand in a drain: you lose a hard hat, and with none left the survey is abandoned.

481411.overview:
Tokyo, year 19XX
a vast amount of gummy, elastic and completely harmless creatures are now inhabiting the streets of Tokyo.
Everyone loves them. Someone lays on them (they feel like gummy memory foam and they're pleasantly warm), someone uses them as stress relief.
But there is someone that has more nefarious plans! The evil doctor  Schmallenweiner plans to kidnap all the mopi and turn them into fuel to power his personal kaiju, mechamopizilla!
And that's where you come in! Join Hatsune Mopi and her cat Koneko in their salvage operation! Rescue all the mopi from the clutches of the evil doctor and his henchmen!

481540.overview: Mappy is the Commodore 64 port of the 1983 Namco arcade game. It comes as a disk image (.d64) and as a cartridge image (.crt), and it needs a 1 MB REU (RAM Expansion Unit), real or emulated. The same files work on European (PAL) and American (NTSC) machines: at start-up the game checks which one it is on.

481650.overview: Get both children through the gate before daylight breaks...

481744.overview: Magister Militum is a skirmish-simulation with a planning phase and real time battles. You can build your armies from a wide range of unit types. Position them strategically on the battlefield to defeat your enemies through tactical skill.

481960.overview: Legend says in 1542 the city watch in Gangelt was too drunk to find the pin (Penn) for the city gate's latch, so they used a big carrot (Muhre) instead.

481963.overview: This is a free platform game set on Mars for the Commodore 64 Ultimate and the Commodore 77. You drive a Mars buggy across the lunar surface, leaping over craters, blasting apart boulders, and fighting against flying saucers.

481970.overview: MicroCity is a city simulation game

481977.overview: 32×24 tile map, procedurally generated: canyons, lowlands, flatlands, craters, highlands, mountains, polar ice and buried deposits (ice, iron, silicon, regolith), rendered as an interlocking hexagon grid and viewed through a scrolling 6×6 viewport that follows the cursor.

482036.overview: MEODOKU 64 is a brand-new logic puzzle game for the Commodore 64. The board is split into coloured areas – your job is to give every area exactly one cat. Sounds easy?

482042.overview: In MAZEQUAKE!, you must navigate through five unique environments, each featuring its own atmosphere, challenging pathways, and mysterious twists and turns.

482047.overview: MIAMI 84 is an open-city action game for the Commodore 64. Drive through Miami, make money, raid cartel hideouts and follow Jack through a fourteen-chapter crime story where your choices lead to five possible endings.

482163.overview: "Munchie" is an educational game that promotes basic math skills in a playful way. Players solve problems in addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Each correct answer moves the green Pac-Man closer to the goal, while each wrong answer allows the ghost to catch up. The game combines learning math with an exciting race to escape the ghost and reach the goal.

482572.overview: A 70s-80s cop game in a C64 version. Racing, bumping, shooting, and catching criminals. Drive, ram, and mete out justice, Italian style!

482754.overview:
Captain Cole Skimmer, top pilot and Star Marshal of the Federation, has volunteered for a test flight on the Moon.
His mission is simple: to fly the MK5 "Flatfish" interceptor craft a few laps around the Moon surface.
Suddenly, he receives an urgent radio message:
"Starbase calling Captain Skimmer... Abort the test flight! Your sector is being invaded by the Cozzi Clone Gang. Return to base immediately!"
The Cozzi gang, all identical clones, specialize in hit-and-run raids and protection rackets.
Skimmer ignores the order, and decides to take on the gang himself with the MK5 interceptor...

482757.overview: Climb into your striped balloon, float over moonlit villages, jungles, pyramids and pagodas, and stop the bandits shooting at you from the ground. Drop sacks from above, dodge arrows, stones and shells, watch out for birds dropping eggs - and take down a giant boss every three levels.

482790.overview: Morphy wants to make delicious cherry jam! Jump, run and collect cherries through the city, garden, forest, countryside and farm. But Blip, Blop, Mibo, Squzz and Wobo prefer strawberry jam and will try to stop him. Can Morphy reach the shop and complete his mission?

482916.overview: fight gravity, watch your fuel and soft-land your lunar module on the glowing pads.
